info.longName: Fidelity Electric Vehicles and Future Transportation ETF

funds_data.description: The fund normally invests at least 80% of the fund's assets in securities included in the index and in depositary receipts representing securities included in the index. The index is designed to reflect the performance of a global universe of companies across the market capitalization spectrum engaged in the production of electric and/or autonomous vehicles and their components, technology, or energy systems, or engaged in other initiatives that aim to change the future of transportation.
